name: Helmlab 2026 test vectors

reference.package: helmlab (Python), loaded from src/helmlab of the repository
reference.note: source_tree is the git tree id of src/helmlab. Its files equal tag v1.0.0 (commit 96a0f16) except the version string in __init__.py ("1.0.2") and docstrings in src/helmlab/helmlab.py (same syntax tree once docstrings are removed).
reference.calling_convention: One reference call with an input of shape (1, 3) per input (spec Appendix A.2); GenSpace(), MetricSpace(), MetricSpace(neutral_correction=True) and Helmlab() are built once and reused.

xyz-astm-d65.note: reference frame; the reference calls take these values

frames.A_definition: Bradford adaptation from the astm white to the css white, A = M_BFD^-1 * diag((M_BFD*W_css)_i / (M_BFD*W_astm)_i) * M_BFD with M_BFD = [[0.8951, 0.2664, -0.1614], [-0.7502, 1.7135, 0.0367], [0.0389, -0.0685, 1.0296]] (Lam 1985 as tabulated by Lindbloom), computed in exact rational arithmetic; A*W_astm = W_css exactly; the floats above are A rounded; B = A^-1 (exact) maps xyz-css-d65 to xyz-astm-d65
frames.rule: Every xyz-css-d65 value in this file is A times the xyz-astm-d65 binary64 value, computed exactly and rounded once per component, and the expected outputs are computed from the xyz-astm-d65 values only.

tolerances.note: absolute, per channel; forward: the coordinates, inverse: XYZ. Level R: the helmlab packages, XYZ in xyz-astm-d65. Level U: other implementations, XYZ (inputs of forward rows, outputs of inverse rows) in the frame of the implementation, xyz-astm-d65 or xyz-css-d65
tolerances.lch: L and C as coordinates; hue as the chord C*|dh|, dh in radians wrapped to [-pi, pi], C the expected chroma, with the tolerance of C

domain_rules: helmgen and helmgenlch: in if 0 <= Y <= 10 and every component of M1*XYZ is >= 0 (M1 of params/gen_params.json, sign decided in exact rational arithmetic); helmlab-metric and helmlab-metric-neutral: in if the colour lies in the Display P3 or the Rec.2020 gamut, that is every component of (B*M)^-1 * XYZ is in [-1e-6, 1 + 1e-6] for M = lin_P3_to_XYZ or M = lin_2020_to_XYZ of CSS Color 4 (B of frames, exact rational arithmetic; the slack admits rounding, such as the sRGB white of spec Section 5.2, Y = 1.0000000102999; every sRGB colour of Section 5.2 lies in the Rec.2020 gamut, and some lie up to 1.1e-5 outside the Display P3 gamut); deltaE: in if both colours are in the MetricSpace domain; an inverse row has the flag of the forward row with the same id; XYZ and Y are the xyz-astm-d65 values; otherwise out.
level_rules: A row in the domain has level U and is checked for every implementation (helmlab packages at level R, other implementations at level U); a row out of the domain has level R and is checked only for the helmlab packages, except level info (checked by no level) when (a) an output is not finite, (b) the one-row result and a batch result (one call with all inputs of the file for that op, shape (N, 3)) differ by more than the level R tolerance, (c) for an inverse row, the one-row forward of the expected XYZ differs from the row's input by more than 1e-8 (helmgenlch: L, C and the chord C*|dh|), or (d) for an inverse row, adding or subtracting 1e-12 to one channel of the input moves the output by more than 1e-8 (one batch call over the six changed inputs of each row).

de-near.made: A colour is a Rec.2020 linear u = rng.uniform(0, 1, 3) (so Y <= 1), redrawn while C0 < 1e-4; XYZ by CSS Color 4 conversions.js (Editor's Draft, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/conversions.js, downloaded 2026-11-09): the binary64 linear values taken as exact fractions, the matrix lin_2020_to_XYZ and B (css to astm, see frames) in exact rational arithmetic, rounded once per component. All draws come from one numpy.random.default_rng(2030): de-near/0..999 first, then de-far/0..999. lab1 and lab2 are helmlab-metric.fwd outputs (one-row), deltaE is distance_from_lab (one-row). de-near/n: colour 1 is u; colour 2 is clip(u + 10**e*d, 0, 1) with d = v/|v|, v = rng.standard_normal(3), |v| = sqrt(v[0]*v[0] + v[1]*v[1] + v[2]*v[2]) in binary64, then e = rng.uniform(-4, -1); v and e are redrawn while colour 2 has C0 < 1e-4.

de-far.made: A colour is a Rec.2020 linear u = rng.uniform(0, 1, 3) (so Y <= 1), redrawn while C0 < 1e-4; XYZ by CSS Color 4 conversions.js (Editor's Draft, https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color-4/conversions.js, downloaded 2026-11-09): the binary64 linear values taken as exact fractions, the matrix lin_2020_to_XYZ and B (css to astm, see frames) in exact rational arithmetic, rounded once per component. All draws come from one numpy.random.default_rng(2030): de-near/0..999 first, then de-far/0..999. lab1 and lab2 are helmlab-metric.fwd outputs (one-row), deltaE is distance_from_lab (one-row). de-far/n: two colours drawn one after the other.
